prompt: automake parallel make recovery locking portable test-and-set command
answer:
`mkdir` is the portable test-and-set command. The Automake recovery rule uses:

```sh
if mkdir data.lock 2>/dev/null; then
    # First process: perform the recovery
fi
```

The lock directory ensures that only one parallel recovery instance rebuilds `data.stamp`.
